_comment: Required-CI expectations of the browser suite (D-044 item 2). In CI mode (WRIT_BROWSER_CI=1) run.mjs refuses to run unless Node has node_major and Chrome's major is at least chrome_min_major, and fails unless the flows loaded from FLOW_MODULES number exactly expected_flow_count and every one of them ran. Update expected_flow_count in the same commit that adds or removes a flow.
